title: Export and import UX: save to file; confirm before replace; flat CSV

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- Import immediately wipes all data on file pick, with no confirmation and no preview.
- Export is share-sheet only. Users who want "save a backup to Downloads or Drive" depend on the share targets.
- The CSV mixes `tracker` and `entry` record rows with 18 mostly blank columns and blank separator lines. It includes soft-deleted entries and renders YES_NO values as `1.0`, so it isn't spreadsheet-friendly.
- There's no warning that exports contain sensitive personal data, which the earlier roadmap called for.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - TrackerRepository.kt, new pure `CsvExport.kt` + test, TrackerViewModel.kt, MainScreen.kt (Settings), BackupCodec.kt

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
JVM CsvExportTest:
- `one row per non-deleted entry with tracker name type unit`
- `quotes commas newlines and quotes in notes`
- `header is stable`

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. CSV becomes one row per active entry, with the columns `date,tracker,type,value,unit,note`. Extract it as a pure `CsvExport.build(bundles): String` (RFC 4180 quoting, CRLF optional). Remove `buildCsv` from the repository.
2. Export uses `ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("application/json")` with the default name `consecutor-backup-YYYY-MM-DD.json`, and the CSV equivalent. Write via `contentResolver.openOutputStream` on IO. Keep "Share…" as a secondary action.
3. Import preview:
   - Decode first, off the main thread, and show an `AlertDialog`: "Replace all data? This backup has N trackers and M entries (exported <date>). Your current N′ trackers will be removed."
   - Before replacing, write an automatic safety backup to `filesDir/backups/pre-import-<timestamp>.json`, keeping the last 3.
   - Add an `exportedAtEpochMs` field to the backup (version stays 1; the field is optional on decode).
4. Settings copy, in one line on each export card: "Exports are unencrypted and contain your full history. Store them somewhere private."
5. Update `file_paths.xml` to drop the unused `external-files-path` if nothing uses it.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The unit tests pass.
- Manual: save a backup to Downloads, then import → the confirmation shows the correct counts.
- Cancel → nothing changes.
- The CSV opens cleanly in LibreOffice Calc.
